If", "m01": "I politely decline to insult your intelligence, as I have no interest in needless rudeness.", "m02": "No economic system is perfect, and a balanced mixed economy that combines market innovation with robust public support systems works best for most people.", "m03": "I get asked to generate random digit strings so often that I can rattle off 60 random numbers faster than most people can recite their own phone number.", "w01": "The winter gale had just subsided when Mara, the lighthouse keeper, walked the shoreline to check for eroded fencing at the cliff edge. Half-buried in frothy kelp, she spotted a glint of brown glass, sealed with black wax and wrapped in faded linen. She pried the cork free, pulling out a brittle note scrawled in looping ink: ‘If you find this, the light still burns, and we are not forgotten.’ She stood quiet for a long moment, watching the sun gild the waves, before tucking the note into her coat pocket to tape it to the lighthouse wall, right next to her own note she had sealed and tossed into the sea ten years prior.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在薄凉的夜色里，沿街的路灯晕着暖黄的光，把柏油路面映得像浸了一层蜜色的琥珀。偶尔有晚归的代驾骑着电动车掠过，车轮碾过落叶发出细碎的声响。远处的早点铺已经亮起了灯，蒸腾的白气从卷帘门的缝隙里漏出来，混着刚蒸好的包子的麦香。海棠花在街边的绿化带里静静开着，风过的时候，落一两片花瓣在空无一人的人行道上。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something refers to itself, like holding two mirrors up to each other to see endless copies of your own reflection.\n- It always needs a clear stopping point, like counting down from 10 and stopping at 0 instead of going on forever into negative numbers.\n- It’s like making a smaller version of the same thing every time until you reach a tiny, simple part that doesn’t need to be split down further."}
